statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The cash close was mixed rather than persistently one-way; oil, long-end yields and Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the block threshold; the next concentrated conditional risk window is Tuesday's 14:25-16:30 Berlin data and cash-open sequence.
headline: Mixed cash close keeps Tail low while oil and yields sustain extreme Stress
body: Reuters' closing cross-market update showed the Nasdaq up 0.17% while the S&P 500 and Dow finished lower. Fresh shared Finviz context also showed sector rotation rather than uniform alignment: Technology +0.15%, 2 of 8 tracked megacaps positive and 4 of 7 tracked semiconductors positive. Independent bar-level NQ evidence of persistent failed retracements was insufficient.
